findings.title: iOS restore() omits finishing/promptAutoFinish/autoFinishDeferred resets that web restoreGame() performs
findings.failure_scenario: restore() reused outside init with stale finishing/deferred -> restored game skips prompt or starts frozen; currently unreachable (restore() init-only).
findings.rationale: Web restoreGame() resets stopFinish/autoFinishDeferred/hideFinishPrompt; iOS restore() resets only selection/history/won/autoplaying — latent parity gap.
findings.suggested_fix: Add finishing=false; promptAutoFinish=false; autoFinishDeferred=false in restore().

findings.title: iOS finish chain has no timer handle/generation token; overlapping chains possible
findings.failure_scenario: mid-finish (.on): Undo sets finishing=false with a block still queued, then a move within ~160ms re-enters runAutoFinish -> two finishStep chains at 2x cadence + double persist; self-heals, no card loss.
findings.rationale: iOS relies solely on the finishing flag and never cancels the pending asyncAfter; web clears a single finishTimer in stopFinish and is immune.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a finish generation counter captured in the closure, or guard runAutoFinish against a pending block.

findings.title: Sequential execution (sendOneHome) untested; detection==execution never asserted; iOS engine untested
findings.failure_scenario: a future edit makes sendOneHome disagree with autoFinishWouldWin (scan order / predicate tweak) -> a finish strands the board and no test catches it.
findings.rationale: engine.mjs exports only autoFinishWouldWin, not sendOneHome; tests only check the predicate on static boards; drift guard pins web/engine.mjs but never iOS.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an execution test that loops a sendOneHome-equivalent to fixpoint and asserts empties whenever autoFinishWouldWin is true.

findings.title: Orphaned old persistence key; default silently flips On->Ask, no migration
findings.failure_scenario: a build from commit 8844567 stored causeway.autofinish=on; upgrading to HEAD ignores it and defaults to Ask.
findings.rationale: Key renamed with default changed On->Ask, no read of legacy key; harmless within one unreleased PR.
findings.suggested_fix: Optional: read legacy bool once and map true->on/false->off, or leave and note it.
